sentences.en: You're overwhelming me with details. I'm suffering from information overload.
sentences.zh: 你给我提供了太多细节。我正遭受信息超载。

sentences.en: The boat was off balance because it was overloaded.
sentences.zh: 因为船超载了，所以失去了平衡。

sentences.en: Overloaded power boards can be a fire hazard.
sentences.zh: 超负荷的电源板可能引发火灾隐患。

senses.zh: 使负担太重；使超载；超过负荷
